description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), causes [Imperil Lightning 20% (25s)], grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Thunderbolt], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Ancient Ancestry Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Thunderbolt
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Lightning abilities

description.name: Ancient Ancestry Mode
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] and [Instant Cast 1] to the character after using five Lightning abilities, removed after triggering
